title: Handley Page Halifax LV955
memorial_details: Rectangular, stained-glass panel in an oak frame, located bottom-right of an older, plain, two-light window. The panel depicts a Halifax bomber flying against a sunlit sky. The 192 Squadron badge and motto are above and below the aircraft. Two brass plaques provide the dedication and the crew names, engraved in black, upper-case letters.
inscription: Upper plaque, reported to read (though not visible on the image): DEDICATED TO THE CREW OF THE HALIFAX LV955 OF 192 SQUADRON / WHICH CRASHED IN THE VILLAGE ON THE 4TH MARCH 1945. // Squadron badge and motto on window: 192 SQUADRON 192 / ROYAL AIR FORCE // DARE TO DISCOVER // Lower brass plaque: (8 NAMES)
